meta.title: Coach Marcus Hughes | Elite Football Training — Atlanta, GA
meta.description: Elite football development in Atlanta. Proven track record of placing athletes at the next level.

about.name: Coach Marcus Hughes
about.title: Head Football Coach
about.bio: Coach Marcus Hughes has spent over a decade developing elite athletes in the Atlanta metro area. A former Division I quarterback, he brings a deep understanding of the mental and physical demands of high-level football. His program has produced multiple college signees and two professional athletes.
about.age_groups: Middle School · High School · College Prep

hero.headline: Where Elite Athletes Are Built
hero.subline: Quarterback and skill development that gets athletes to the next level.

services.title: Elite QB Development
services.description: Mechanics, footwork, pre-snap reads, and film study for quarterbacks serious about playing at the next level.

services.title: Skill Position Training
services.description: Route running, release techniques, hands, and yards-after-catch for WRs, TEs, and running backs.

services.title: College Recruiting Prep
services.description: Film editing, highlight packages, recruiting profile guidance, and coach outreach strategy.

testimonials.quote: Coach Hughes turned my son from a good player into a recruit. We had 8 D1 offers by signing day.

testimonials.quote: The most technical football coach I've ever trained with. He transformed my mechanics in three months.

testimonials.quote: Worth every penny. My son is starting at Georgia this fall.

faq.question: What ages do you work with?
faq.answer: Middle school through college-level athletes. Most of our clients are high school juniors and seniors in the recruiting window.

faq.question: How do I apply for training?
faq.answer: Use the contact form and describe your athlete's goals. We'll schedule an evaluation session to assess fit.

faq.question: Do you offer group sessions?
faq.answer: Limited small-group sessions (3-4 athletes) are available. Most of our training is 1-on-1 for maximum development.

copy_variants.about_tagline: Twelve years. Forty placements. One standard.
